key_highlights: Grim week wipes $169B from Australian equities as macro deterioration accelerates.
Unemployment hits a five-year high, triggering recession warnings across the economy.
Signs of RBA rate hike cycle reaching exhaustion as labor and housing markets buckle.
Accelerating property downturn in Sydney puts severe pressure on mortgage books and consumer sentiment.
Retail stress escalates with mass redundancies at David Jones amid shifting consumer demand.

sectors.trend: Large caps pressured by macro growth fears; juniors find support in gold restarts and rare earth metallurgical advances.
sectors.implications: Speculative capital rotating into gold and critical minerals amid AUD weakness; diversified miners vulnerable to broader demand slowdown.

sectors.trend: Mounting mortgage affordability distress, rapid property value drops, and corporate governance scrutiny.
sectors.implications: Elevated bad-debt risk and compressed net interest margins for major banks (CBA.AX, WBC.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX) as rate hiking cycle concludes.

sectors.trend: Severe discretionary retrenchment with mass department store layoffs; staples adjusting to changing consumption habits and GLP-1 uptake.
sectors.implications: Underweight cyclical retail (MYR.AX, PMV.AX); staples (WOW.AX, COL.AX) offer defensive cash flow but face structural shifts in consumer diet profiles.

sectors.trend: Sharp residential price declines across Sydney and nationwide amid borrowing capacity destruction.
sectors.implications: Asset devaluations and rising cap rates weigh heavily on property trusts (MGR.AX, DXS.AX, GMG.AX).

sectors.trend: Domestic gas market tightness conflicts with political scrutiny and major hydro infrastructure viability concerns.
sectors.implications: Elevated domestic spot gas prices bolster near-term cash flows for gas producers (WDS.AX, STO.AX) despite elevated regulatory risk.

sectors.trend: Workplace disruption and cost-cutting via AI integration alongside robust international venture capital excitement.
sectors.implications: Corporate restructuring reduces domestic white-collar headcount, while AI infrastructure and productivity software maintain valuation premiums.

key_themes: Labour market deterioration pushing the domestic economy toward recessionary conditions.
Peak cash rate realization with the RBA expected to halt further tightening.
Housing downturn acceleration weighing on bank balance sheets and consumer wealth effects.
AUD weakness providing an earnings buffer exclusively for unhedged commodity and offshore revenue earners.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Macroeconomic Recession and Labour Market Contraction
risk_assessment.mitigation: Increase allocations to high-grade sovereign bonds, cash, and non-cyclical defensive equities.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing Market and Mortgage Book Stress
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce exposure to domestic retail lenders and residential property developers.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Persistent AUD Weakness and Imported Inflation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Favor USD-reporting miners and global healthcare leaders over domestic-facing importers.
Avoid exposed department store, apparel, and discretionary retail operators.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight unhedged gold miners and critical mineral developers
opportunities.rationale: Depreciated AUD and capital flight to safe-haven assets boost margins and equity financing for local gold and rare earth producers.

opportunities.recommendation: Position for monetary policy pivot via defensive high-quality healthcare
opportunities.rationale: CSL and peer healthcare leaders provide offshore earnings resilience and valuation expansion as interest rate hiking cycles peak.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim exposure to major domestic commercial banks
defensive_moves.rationale: High interest rates and declining home values amplify credit provisioning risks and curb credit growth.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge benchmark equity beta and eliminate discretionary retail
defensive_moves.rationale: Following a $169B wipeout, downside momentum persists as consumer demand and household savings rate deteriorate.

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish. The ASX 200 (^AXJO) faces persistent headwinds from labour softness, steep property declines, and corporate earnings downgrades.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously neutral. Expected RBA monetary policy easing in 2027 should stabilize debt servicing burdens and establish an equity valuation floor.
key_catalysts: RBA monetary policy statement and cash rate decision
ABS monthly labor force survey and CPI prints
CoreLogic residential home value index updates
China economic activity indicators and iron ore import demand
watch_list: Sydney clearance rates and home price falls
Major bank 90+ day mortgage delinquency trends
